title: Savior, All My Sins Confessing
description: Savior, All My Sins Confessing in Tonic Solfa to ALL FOR JESUS, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Thomas Haweis wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 14.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Eights and Sevens (8.7.8.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ALL FOR JESUS; any other Eights and Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Sa-vior, all my sins con-fes-sing, Gra-cious hear me when I cry; Give through faith the pro-mised bless-ing, Free-ly, ful-ly jus-ti-fy.

lines: Gracious hear me when I cry;
Give through faith the promised blessing,
Bring me to Thy bosom nigh;
So, the days of conflict ended,
In the mansions of the sky,

licence: Public domain: Thomas Haweis died in 1820.
credits: Words by Thomas Haweis (1734–1820), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to ALL FOR JESUS by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
